items.Sentence: Historical use of unlined treatment ponds has caused degradation in underlying groundwater at the WWTP.
All treatment ponds are now only used for emergency purpose.
Pond 1 will be lined that would minimize potential salinity impacts to groundwater.
the blended effluent from the reservoir had an average TDS concentration of 306 mg/L

Based on a comparison of groundwater data collected at the WWTP and the Ranch LAA sites, ... indicates that both the wastewater treatment process and land application likely contribute to groundwater degradation for salinity.
